nodes.label: ADR 0024: Tenant Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: organizations.paymentStatus is the authoritative lifecycle state. States: created→trial→active↔past_due→suspended→cancelled→deleted. Suspend semantics: block charges + block app login (middleware returns 403 for suspended/cancelled). Platform-admin bypass. forceCancelTenant: calls stripe.subscriptions.cancel(), sets paymentStatus='cancelled', audits. issueTenantCredit: adds negative customer balance in Stripe for next invoice. reTrialTenant: extends trialEndsAt, sets paymentStatus='active', does NOT modify Stripe sub.
alternatives_rejected: Stripe as source of truth (every gate check requires Stripe API call)
Half-suspend block charges only (tenant staff books appointments customers can't pay)
Hard delete on cancel (legal hold, dispute, refund needs data)
